tasks.purpose: Decide whether a requested engineering claim is supported by the supplied licensed evidence.
tasks.supported_result: Return the exact supported claim with evidence ID and provenance.
tasks.unsupported_result: Return a structured REFUSE result without inventing a claim.

tasks.purpose: Select the evidence passage that supports a requested materials or process claim.
tasks.supported_result: Return the supported claim and exact selected evidence ID.
tasks.unsupported_result: Return a structured REFUSE result when no passage supports the request.

tasks.purpose: Extract one evidence-bounded engineering claim from the supplied passage.
tasks.supported_result: Return the exact claim, citation, and provenance.
tasks.unsupported_result: Return a structured REFUSE result when the requested claim is absent.
